verdict.rationale: First-party docs show sandbox.exec() running shell commands with stdout, stderr and exit-code capture, plus streaming output, stdin, background processes, and bash-based sessions with their own env and cwd. Each sandbox is described as an isolated container with a full Linux environment, and guides cover running Docker and Git inside it, which strongly implies package installation works. Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of installing packages (e.g. pip/npm/apt) and independent or hands-on corroboration of arbitrary command execution.
